column4: RECOIL rejects Pack-Ice packed TRP. ICE! header (Pack-Ice: fileformats.archiveteam.org/wiki/Pack-Ice; EggPaint page on AtariForumWiki says EggPaint files are often Ice-packed); packed length equals the file size, the stream consumes exactly to its start, and the unpacked size is exactly 8 + w*h*2 for the TRUP header (384x240). Output reviewed: clean painting of a woman with a bottle by candlelight.
